هذا 
المستند يوضح خطوات 
اجراءات الصيانة الدورية على اجهزة التربينة بعد خروج الوحدة من الخدمة وتحت طلب 
قسم صيانة التربينة بعمل الصيانة المطلوبة على كراسى التربينة حيث يتم فك جميع 
اجهزة القياس الموجودة على الكراسى التى يقوم قسم صيانة التوربينات باجراء الصيانة 
عليها

اعد المستند المهندس/ أيمن 
محمد عبد المجيد 
وراجعة واختبره المهندس/ 
محمد عبد المحسن محمد 
ووافق علية المهندس/ عبد العظيم جمعه هجرس مدير عام اسيوط الحرارية واعتمد من السيد 
المهندس/ حسين أحمد المهدى رئيس القطاع ووثق من السيد المهندس/ جمال الدين عبد 
الوهاب رئيس قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة ومنسق الشركة للـ

الانتظار فترة كافية بعد الخروج بالوحدة لحين انخفاض درجة حرارة عامود التربينة 
 الى درجة حرارة 50 درجة مئوية تقريبا

اصدار امر شغل معتمد من قسم التشغيل بالمحطة موقع عليه من فنيين قسم صيانة 
 الاجهزة المكلفين باداء اعمال الصيانة تحت اشراف السيد مهندس الصيانة المنفذ 
 لامر الشغل المعتمد من رئيس قسم صيانة الاجهزة

يتم تسجيل فئة 
 السلامة والصحة المهنية لكل الافراد العاملين بأمر الشغل

يتم التأكد من ايقاف طلمبات الزيت الموجود على التربينة وذلك بعد فصل التغذية 
 عنها جهد 380 فولت تيار متردد وجهد 110 فولت تيار ثابت
يتم التأكد من ايقاف عامود الدورات البطيئة للتربينة

Instrumentation and Control
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: MI-002-r0a
Equipment: Instruments installed on turbine No. (2), ABB
Issued to: Assiut 3, 30 MW
Status: Approved
Approval date: 25 March 2007
Procedure: Adjustment of instruments
Next review date: March 2012

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps of the periodic maintenance procedures on the turbine instruments after the unit is taken out of service, at the request of the Turbine Maintenance Department to carry out the required maintenance on the turbine bearings, whereby all the measuring instruments installed on the bearings on which the Turbine Maintenance Department carries out maintenance are dismantled.

The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Magid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Mohamed Abdel Mohsen Mohamed, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal, and approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and the company coordinator for the
Wait a sufficient period after taking the unit out of service until the turbine shaft temperature drops to approximately 50 °C

Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department, signed by the instrument maintenance technicians assigned to carry out the maintenance work under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work permit approved by the Head of the Instrument Maintenance Department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel working under the work permit
Check that the oil pumps on the turbine are stopped, after isolating their supply: 380 V AC and 110 V DC
Check that the turbine slow-speed shaft is stopped

items: Wait a sufficient period after taking the unit out of service until the turbine shaft temperature drops to approximately 50 °C

Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department, signed by the instrument maintenance technicians assigned to carry out the maintenance work under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work permit approved by the Head of the Instrument Maintenance Department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel working under the work permit
Check that the oil pumps on the turbine are stopped, after isolating their supply: 380 V AC and 110 V DC
Check that the turbine slow-speed shaft is stopped

rows: Dismantle the instruments installed on bearings No. (1), (2), (3), (4) at the request of the Turbines Department
Dismantle the speed instruments
Dismantle the displacement transmitter (sensor)
Dismantle the vibration transmitter (sensor) on bearing No. (1)
Dismantle the thermometer for the steam temperature entering the turbine
Dismantle the two thermocouples for measuring the oil temperature of bearing (1) (front and rear)
Dismantle the 0–200 °C and 0–100 °C thermometers for measuring the bearing metal temperature
Dismantle the (sensor) for turbine displacement
Dismantle the (2) sensors for turbine vibration
Dismantle the (2) thermocouples for oil temperature
Dismantle the (2) thermometers for bearing temperature
Dismantle the turbine speed instrument
Dismantle the oil pressure gauge
Dismantle the bearing metal cable
Dismantle the thermometer for steam temperature
Dismantle the thermometer on bearing No. 2, west, 0–100 °C
Dismantle the generator cooling air thermometer, east, 0–100 °C
Dismantle the thermometer, right-hand east, 0–100 °C
Dismantle the thermometer, north-east, 0–100 °C
Dismantle the (2) vibration sensors
Dismantle the (2) thermocouples for oil temperature
Dismantle the (2) vibration sensors
Dismantle the circular thermometer, 0–100 °C
Dismantle the thermocouple for oil temperature measurement
Dismantle the glycerine-filled pressure gauge, 0–160
Reinstall all the measuring instruments dismantled from bearings (1), (2), (3), (4) in the same position as before dismantling

Adjust the displacement measuring instrument by adjusting the fastening nut of the displacement sensor while measuring the voltage of the displacement converter so that it gives half the supply voltage value, 24 V DC, ensuring it gives the correct value (zero mm) on the recorder in the thermal room, after the Turbine Maintenance Department has mechanically adjusted the position of the turbine shaft

Adjust the vibration measuring instruments on the turbine bearings by adjusting the fastening nut on the vibration sensor while measuring the voltage of the vibration converter for each bearing so that it gives half the supply voltage value, 24 V DC, ensuring it gives the correct value (zero micrometres) on the recorder in the thermal room
Reconnect the supply voltage, 380 V AC, 110 V DC
Close the work permit

This document sets out the steps of the periodic maintenance procedures on the turbine instruments after the unit is taken out of service, at the request of the Turbine Maintenance Department to carry out the required maintenance on the turbine bearings, whereby all the measuring instruments installed on the bearings on which the Turbine Maintenance Department carries out maintenance are dismantled.
The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Magid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Mohamed Abdel Mohsen Mohamed, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal, and approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel working under the work permit

Check that the turbine slow-speed shaft is stopped

Check that the turbine slow-speed shaft is stopped
